claims.text: Advanced machine-learning techniques can improve the accuracy of determining thermodynamic properties of high-entropy alloys.
Advanced machine-learning techniques can improve the efficiency of determining thermodynamic properties of high-entropy alloys.
The intervention applies to high-entropy alloys in high-temperature solid states.
The intervention applies to high-entropy alloys in liquid states.
Machine-learning models mediate the proposed improvement.
Advanced machine-learning techniques improve thermodynamic-property prediction.
The intervention will improve the accuracy and efficiency of determining melting temperature relative to current experimental and computational methods.
The intervention will improve the accuracy and efficiency of determining enthalpy of fusion relative to current experimental and computational methods.
The intervention will improve the accuracy and efficiency of determining entropy of fusion relative to current experimental and computational methods.
The intervention will improve the accuracy and efficiency of determining volume change upon melting relative to current experimental and computational methods.
The intervention will improve the accuracy and efficiency of determining liquid thermodynamic properties relative to current experimental and computational methods.
Current experimental and computational methods have limited availability and accuracy for determining the targeted properties.
The proposed intervention is applicable across a large compositional space.
Comparison with independent reference data can test the hypothesis.
